**Finding: missing (medium severity) — TRANSITION**

The agreement has no post-termination transition assistance or data-return obligation on Garman:

- **§ 17(b)** imposes exit obligations only on us (cease use; certify destruction/return of Software, Documentation and Codes within 30 days).
- **§ 17(c)/(d)** deals with insolvency/default termination and a perpetual-licence conversion, but says nothing about our data.
- **§ 14 (Confidentiality)** has no return-or-destroy mechanic at all; **§ 18 (Survival)** simply preserves existing clauses.
- **§ 16 (Source Code Escrow)** is only a partial substitute — it secures Garman's code, not the Sparkling business data converted into the system under **§ 4**.

Because neither the preferred nor the fallback position (90 days' assistance plus 30-day export) exists anywhere, this is a genuine gap rather than a sub-optimal clause. I proposed a new **§ 17(d)** at the preferred position — up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, machine-readable return of our data within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter — with 90 days' assistance flagged in the comment as an acceptable fallback. Redline validated (ok:true) and the finding is submitted.
